name: Code review
description: Deterministic mutation-seeded Python snippets for calibrating and evaluating code-review models.

category_descriptions.sql_injection: Untrusted input is concatenated into SQL instead of passed as a bound parameter.
category_descriptions.off_by_one: A loop or slice starts or stops one element away from the intended boundary.
category_descriptions.missing_await: An asynchronous operation is called without awaiting its result.
category_descriptions.unbounded_query: A query materializes every matching row instead of respecting a result limit.
category_descriptions.missing_authorization: A sensitive operation returns or updates a record without checking the caller's permission.
category_descriptions.path_traversal: A caller-controlled path component reaches a filesystem operation without normalization.
